overview_description.description: Keyper is a property technology company that provides a digital platform for property management, rental services, and real estate investment management. It enables property owners to manage residential properties, tenants to pay rent through flexible monthly installments, and partners to facilitate rental-related services through a centralized platform. The company also offers tools for lease administration, rent collection, maintenance coordination, property performance tracking, and real estate insights supported by data and digital workflows. In addition, it provides marketplace and investment management features that support property transactions and portfolio oversight. Its platform integrates property management, rental payments, and investment management services to streamline interactions among property owners, tenants, investors, and business partners.
